notes.back:
No. `value.toUpperCase()` fails: it does not exist on type 'number'. `value.length` compiles.

Why: Without narrowing you may only use what every member of the union has. Both strings and arrays have length; numbers have no toUpperCase.

Docs: TypeScript Handbook — Everyday Types — https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/2/everyday-types.html
